usedFor: CheckFlow tracks task checklists, and HubSpot receives a deal when “Create Deal” follows “Task Is Completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Is Completed” in CheckFlow, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A finished task, such as a qualification step, opens the deal in HubSpot at the right moment.

watchOut: “Task Is Completed” fires for every finished task, so scope the template or each completion creates another deal.
